lines.text: Many learners say: I will see you after five minutes.
Better: I will see you in five minutes.
In! The bus comes in five minutes.

data.wrong: I will see you after five minutes.
data.right: I will see you in five minutes.

native.tip: Время от сейчас — “in”: “I will see you in five minutes”.
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I will see you after five minutes.”? 😅 По-русски «через пять минут», но в английском “after” не подходит. Нужно “in”. Правильно: “I will see you in five minutes.”. Послушай Ама и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.

en.tip: For time from now, use “in”: “I will see you in five minutes”.
en.caption: Do you also say “I will see you after five minutes.”? 😅 In Russian we say “cherez pyat' minut”, but English needs “in”, not “after”. Correct: “I will see you in five minutes.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
